name: Agile
text: Creatures with Agile have an additional, independent chance to dodge attacks.

name: Arcane
text: When an Arcane creature Casts a spell, the spell does not consume any Charges.

name: Barrier
text: Barrier absorbs a certain amount of damage. After the maximum amount of damage is dealt, the buff is removed. Barrier strength cannot exceed 200% of a creature's highest stat when this buff is applied.

name: Defensive
text: Creatures with Defensive automatically Defend at the end of their turn.

name: Immune
text: Creatures with Immune can't be afflicted with debuffs.

name: Invisible
text: Invisible creatures cannot be manually targeted by enemy attacks or spells. This buff is removed after the creature takes an action.

name: Leeching
text: Creatures with Leeching recover Health equal to 25% of the damage they deal.

name: Mending
text: Creatures with Mending recover 30% Health at the start of their turn.

name: Proficient
text: Proficient creatures gain 30% more benefits from their Artifact's Stat Slots, other than Health.

name: Protected
text: Creatures with Protected take 50% less damage.

name: Rebirth
text: Creatures with Rebirth are resurrected with 50% Health when they die.

name: Repelling
text: Repelling creatures have a 50% chance to ignore damage from spells.

name: Savage
text: Savage creatures have an additional, independent chance to deal critical damage with attacks.

name: Shelled
text: Shelled negates the next incoming attack or spell.

name: Splashing
text: Creatures with Splashing deal 50% of their damage to enemies adjacent to the target they Attack.

name: Taunting
text: Creatures with Taunting automatically Provoke at the end of their turn.

name: Warded
text: Creatures with Warded cannot lose stats.
